authority.note: This is a pacing contract, not a full progression package. It deliberately carries no quest, objective, intent or allowlist identifiers: those belong to a progression package and to DA_MelodiaIntegrationConfig, and adding them requires owner allowlist sign-off. The 'pacing' object below conforms to the progression package's pacing definition.

scope.replacement_reason: The P0 route is now Poitou's seven-beat First Day. The First Dream package's pacing block still described the old five-beat shape with a 420 s combat window and had not been updated.
scope.runtime_status: DESIGN CONTRACT. Not runtime-wired. The gating systems for these beats are the existing StoryDoor / TraversalGate / PuzzleRelay / StateAnchor authorities duplicated as *_FirstDay, which has not been authored yet. No beat in this contract is runtime-proven.
scope.combat_note: This route has no rhythm-combat beat. That is a design fact of the First Day route, not a statement about the turn-based ARPG / ACFU hybrid canon, which remains the combat identity and is still pending owner ratification of its four ownership questions (see CURRENT_STATE.md, OWNER CANON, 2026-10-11).

meter.note: Single governing meter. The earlier '2.4 m = allegro 3/4 / 3.6 m = andante 4/4' phrasing is superseded. Tempo authority of UMelodiaMusicClockSubsystem (global tempo, per-zone key) must be confirmed before authoring any tempo-locked clip.

duration_arithmetic.piano_footbridge_minutes_at_1_28_mps: beat 2 only, 1 bar = 2.4 m = 1.875 s per bar
duration_arithmetic.note: 1600 m at Melusina's 2.2 m/s walk is 12.1 minutes with no stops; the 15-20 minute window therefore only closes if the route has 3-8 minutes of stops and interaction. If the beats are walked without stopping, the route overruns its own budget.

readability_obligations: The arrival at the jetty is legible before the first choice: the steeple is visible through the mist and the abbey reads as a distant landmark.
Walking and camera are the only inputs required. Nothing is taught here that the player cannot do.
Step = note is unmistakable: each footfall on the piano footbridge plays a pitch and the melody answers.
The player can stop and keep playing; the bridge is not a fail state.
The ruin framed by the pollard ash is the first visual reveal and is legible from the bridge, not only from the far bank.
The crane is a playable decor node and says so before it is used.
The punt crossing is optional; the market rhythm reads without it.
The StepGrid paving puzzle opens the StoryDoor and its result is visible: the door moves.
The first full abbey view is in the frame here and nowhere earlier.
This beat teaches nothing new. It is the first optional branch and the first collectible stop.
The lane drops to the conche and the lock is visible to the east before the player is asked to cross it.
The lock gate opens on its TraversalGate flag and the opening is legible from the alley.
The allee vanishing point is the ruin; long shadows at 17:00 read as the route cue.
The ArpeggioStair climb is the vertical reward and the ruin is legible from the top.
The finale plays full tutti and then silence; the silence is the beat.
